payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design with nature distilled aesthetic. Use: muted earthy colors (terracotta, sand, olive), organic materials feel, warm tones, handmade warmth, natural textures, artisan quality, sustainable vibe, soft gradients.
payload.best_for: Wellness brands, sustainable products, artisan goods, organic food, spa/beauty, home decor
payload.css_technical_keywords: background: warm earth tones, color: #C67B5C #D4C4A8 #6B7B3C, border-radius: organic (varied), box-shadow: soft natural, texture overlays (grain), font: humanist sans-serif
payload.do_not_use_for: Tech startups, gaming, nightlife, corporate finance, high-energy brands
payload.effects_and_animation: Subtle parallax, natural easing (ease-out), texture overlays, grain effects, soft shadows
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Earth tones dominant, ☐ Warm feel achieved, ☐ Textures subtle, ☐ Handmade quality, ☐ Sustainable messaging, ☐ Calming aesthetic
payload.keywords: Muted earthy, skin tones, wood, soil, sand, terracotta, warmth, organic materials, handmade warmth
payload.primary_colors: Terracotta #C67B5C, Sand Beige #D4C4A8, Warm Clay #B5651D, Soft Cream #F5F0E1
payload.secondary_colors: Earth Brown #8B4513, Olive Green #6B7B3C, Warm Stone #9C8B7A, muted gradients
